product_overview: Pav Dental is a mobile-first dental care app for patients to sign in, view their dashboard, browse dental services, and review dental records. It also supports care-channel discovery and access to treatment plans and document vault content.
core_goals: Access the app and sign in with email and password
View a personalized patient dashboard with care-channel and booking information
Browse available dental services and care options
Review dental records, odontogram details, treatment plans, and document vault items

features.name: Welcome and Authentication Flow
features.description: Allows users to enter the app, move from the welcome screen to email entry, and sign in with existing patient credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /welcome -> View the welcome screen -> Choose to continue with email -> Enter an email address -> Proceed to password login -> Enter a password -> Sign in and reach the patient area
Navigate to /welcome -> View the welcome screen -> Choose the quick demo access option -> Reach the patient area

features.name: Patient Home and Care Catalog
features.description: Lets authenticated patients view their home dashboard and explore care channels and available services.
user_flows: Navigate to the patient home area -> View the personalized greeting -> Review the upcoming appointment summary or booking prompt -> View available care channels -> Browse active dental services and pricing -> Switch between Home and Care tabs
Navigate to the care area -> View dental care channels -> Browse available services with pricing and duration -> Return to the home dashboard

features.name: Dental Records and Odontogram
features.description: Gives patients access to their dental chart, treatment plans, and document vault for record review.
user_flows: Navigate to the records area -> View the 32-tooth odontogram -> Inspect tooth conditions across the upper and lower arches -> Review treatment plans -> Open document vault items
Navigate to the records area -> View treatment plans -> Review available plan details -> Open the document vault to inspect stored documents
